## LPIPS settlement
- The screen-set pattern (full feedback worse than single, DCT-4 better) **replicates in sign** on the second set. Full feedback's LPIPS increase is significant on both sets. DCT-4's decrease is significant on the screen set only.
- PSNR and latent move the other way: full feedback has the best PSNR and latent on both sets. Full feedback improves pixel/latent fidelity but worsens LPIPS, while DCT-4 improves all three moderately.

## DCT-16 trade-off read (user swap, pre-registered)
| set | single | DCT-4 | DCT-16 | full | latent between | PSNR between | LPIPS ≤ single |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| screen | 0.1844 / 18.11 / 0.3778 | 0.1701 / 18.54 / 0.3633 | 0.1793 / 18.29 / 0.3692 | 0.1599 / 18.69 / 0.3933 | False | False | True |
| untouched | 0.1921 / 17.66 / 0.3965 | 0.1761 / 18.15 / 0.3845 | 0.1851 / 17.89 / 0.3851 | 0.1671 / 18.32 / 0.4178 | False | False | True |

Cells: latent rel. MSE / PSNR / LPIPS.
**Trade-off exists: False.** DCT-16 is worse than DCT-4 on latent and PSNR on both sets, so the curve is not monotone in k between 4 and full. No band-limited setting is recommended on this evidence. The D3 lower-bound clause does not apply.

## Deployed cost (separate from simulation time)
| bed | arm | persistent state per image | extra per element per step | extra FLOPs per step |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- | ---: |
| DiT-XL/2 256 (112 sites, batch-32 measured / 32) | full feedback | 220.5 MiB | 1 add + 1 subtract + clamp | — |
| DiT-XL/2 256 | DCT-4 feedback | 3.45 MiB | as above, on the synthesized state | projection + synthesis |
| PixArt-Σ 1024² (224 sites, 4096 tokens, 2 CFG rows, fp16) | full feedback | 5.41 GiB | 1 add + 1 subtract + clamp | — |
| PixArt-Σ 1024² | DCT-4 feedback | 5.41 MiB | as above | 46.51 GFLOP |
| PixArt-Σ 1024² | DCT-16 feedback | 21.66 MiB | as above | 186.03 GFLOP |

- The PixArt state sizes are computed from the site shapes (Σ C_in over the 224 static-A8 sites = 354,816). The DiT sizes are the allocated tensors measured in `ext/e2_confirm.json`.
- For scale: one PixArt-Σ forward is ≈ 2 × 0.6 B params × 2 rows × 4096 tokens ≈ 9.8 TFLOP, so the DCT-4 / DCT-16 projections add ≈ 0.5% / 1.9% compute per step (unfused). Full feedback's 5.4 GiB of persistent state per image is the binding deployment cost.
